units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN LITERATURE AND THE ARTS
units.text: 6. Works and projects, and teams nominated for the Prize, shall not be considered if they have been nominated for other prizes or other awards.
units.label: Point 6

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN LITERATURE AND THE ARTS
units.text: 7. Literary works may be nominated for the Prize only after publication, and artistic works only after they have been presented to a broad public at concerts, exhibitions, theatres or cinemas, in the press or on television.
units.label: Point 7

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN LITERATURE AND THE ARTS
units.text: Projects and works nominated for the Prize shall be discussed in creative and public organizations and the mass media, as organized by the Department of Culture of the City of Moscow. Materials from the discussions shall be sent to the Department of Culture of the City of Moscow.
units.label: Point 7 · “Projects and works nominated for the Prize shall be discussed…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN LITERATURE AND THE ARTS
units.text: 8. Works and projects submitted for the Prize shall be considered by the Commission for the Prizes of the City of Moscow in Literature and the Arts (hereinafter, the Commission). The Regulations on the Commission shall be approved by the Mayor of Moscow. The Commission’s membership shall be approved by a legal act of the Department of Culture of the City of Moscow.
units.label: Point 8

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN LITERATURE AND THE ARTS
units.text: After discussing the works and projects nominated for the Prize, the Commission shall adopt at its meetings a decision recommending the award of the current year’s Prizes, by an open vote and a majority of those present.
units.label: Point 8 · “After discussing the works and projects nominated for the…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN LITERATURE AND THE ARTS
units.text: Where works or projects authored by members of the Commission are submitted for the Prize, those members shall be temporarily excluded from its work.
units.label: Point 8 · “Where works or projects authored by members of the Commission…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN LITERATURE AND THE ARTS
units.text: 9. On the basis of the Commission’s proposals, a Decree of the Mayor of Moscow on awarding the Prizes shall be issued.
units.label: Point 9

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN LITERATURE AND THE ARTS
units.text: 10. The Prizes shall be paid by the Department of Culture of the City of Moscow on the basis of the Decree of the Mayor of Moscow on awarding the Prizes.
units.label: Point 10

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN LITERATURE AND THE ARTS
units.text: 11. Where the Prize is awarded to a team of authors, its monetary component shall be divided equally among them.
units.label: Point 11

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN LITERATURE AND THE ARTS
units.text: 12. A laureate may receive the Prize again for new major achievements in literature and the arts.
units.label: Point 12

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN MEDICINE
units.text: 1. The Prize of the City of Moscow in Medicine (hereinafter, the Prize) shall be awarded for the most effective work of physicians, medical scientists and healthcare organizers, distinguished by novelty, originality and reliability, that contributes to the development of practical healthcare and medical science in the City of Moscow and has received public recognition.
units.label: Point 1

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN MEDICINE
units.text: 2. Up to 6 Prizes, each of 3000 thousand roubles, shall be awarded annually on the eve of Medical Workers’ Day.
units.label: Point 2

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN MEDICINE
units.text: 3. Works shall be submitted for the Prize to the Department of Health of the City of Moscow by medical treatment and preventive care institutions, state medical enterprises, Moscow associations of physicians and nurses and other organizations.
units.label: Point 3

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN MEDICINE
units.text: Works shall be accepted by the Department of Health of the City of Moscow annually until 15.01, provided that they were made public at least one year before the closing date for submissions.
units.label: Point 3 · “Works shall be accepted by the Department of Health of the City…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN MEDICINE
units.text: 4. The same author may not be nominated simultaneously for the Prize for two or more works.
units.label: Point 4

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN MEDICINE
units.text: 5. A team nominated for the Prize must include only those authors whose contribution to the work was decisive.
units.label: Point 5

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN MEDICINE
units.text: A team of authors must not comprise more than ten persons.
units.label: Point 5 · “A team of authors must not comprise more than ten persons.”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN MEDICINE
units.text: 6. Works and teams nominated for the Prize shall not be considered if they have been nominated for other prizes or other awards.
units.label: Point 6

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN MEDICINE
units.text: 7. Works in medicine may be nominated for the Prize only after publication, clinical trials and implementation in the city’s practical healthcare.
units.label: Point 7

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN MEDICINE
units.text: Works nominated for the Prize shall be discussed among medical staff collectives, public organizations and the mass media. Materials from the discussions shall be sent to the Department of Health of the City of Moscow.
units.label: Point 7 · “Works nominated for the Prize shall be discussed among medical…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN MEDICINE
units.text: 8. Works submitted for the Prize shall be considered by the expert council for awarding the Prize (hereinafter, the expert council) attached to the Department of Health of the City of Moscow.
units.label: Point 8

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN MEDICINE
units.text: After discussing the works nominated for the Prize, the expert council shall adopt at its meetings a decision recommending the award of the current year’s Prizes, by an open vote and a majority of those present.
units.label: Point 8 · “After discussing the works nominated for the Prize, the expert…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN MEDICINE
units.text: Where works authored by members of the expert council are submitted for the Prize, those members shall be temporarily excluded from its work.
units.label: Point 8 · “Where works authored by members of the expert council are…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN MEDICINE
units.text: 9. The works selected by the expert council shall be forwarded by the Department of Health of the City of Moscow to the Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow for subsequent consideration by the Commission for Awards and Honorary Titles of the City of Moscow.
units.label: Point 9

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN MEDICINE
units.text: 10. On the basis of proposals from the Commission for Awards and Honorary Titles of the City of Moscow, a Decree of the Mayor of Moscow on awarding the Prizes shall be issued.
units.label: Point 10

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN MEDICINE
units.text: 11. The Prizes shall be paid by the Department of Health of the City of Moscow on the basis of the Decree of the Mayor of Moscow on awarding the Prizes.
units.label: Point 11

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN MEDICINE
units.text: 12. Where the Prize is awarded to a team of authors, its monetary component shall be divided equally among them.
units.label: Point 12

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN MEDICINE
units.text: 13. A laureate may receive the Prize again for new major achievements in medicine.
units.label: Point 13

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN EDUCATION
units.text: 1. The Prize of the City of Moscow in Education (hereinafter, the Prize) shall be awarded to the most talented schoolteachers, lecturers, educators and heads of educational organizations who have achieved the highest results in teaching and bringing up children, made a significant contribution to the development of education in the City of Moscow and received public recognition.
units.label: Point 1

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN EDUCATION
units.text: 2. Up to 22 Prizes, each of 1000 thousand roubles, shall be awarded annually on the eve of Teachers’ Day.
units.label: Point 2

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN EDUCATION
units.text: 3. Materials and works shall be submitted for the Prize to the Department of Education and Science of the City of Moscow by meetings of the staff collectives of educational organizations.
units.label: Point 3

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN EDUCATION

units.label: Point 5 · “A team of authors must not comprise more than ten persons.”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN EDUCATION
units.text: 6. Materials and works submitted for the Prize shall not be considered if they have been nominated for other prizes or the candidates have been nominated for other awards.
units.label: Point 6

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN EDUCATION
units.text: 7. Materials concerning individual candidates and works in education may be nominated for the Prize only after publication, implementation in educational practice and discussion among teaching staff collectives, public organizations and the mass media.
units.label: Point 7

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN EDUCATION
units.text: Materials from the discussions shall be sent to the Department of Education and Science of the City of Moscow.

units.label: Point 8

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN EDUCATION
units.text: After discussing the materials and works nominated for the Prize, the expert council shall adopt at its meeting a decision recommending the award of the current year’s Prizes, by an open vote and a majority of those present.

units.text: Where works authored by members of the expert council are submitted for the Prize, those members shall be temporarily excluded from its work.

units.text: 9. units.label: Point 9

units.locator: ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN PHYSICAL CULTURE AND SPORT
units.text: 1. The Prize of the City of Moscow in Physical Culture and Sport (hereinafter, the Prize) shall be awarded for the most significant activities and works aimed at improving citizens’ health and organizing active recreation, developing their desire for physical improvement and harmonious personal development, involving children and young people in regular sports activities, and developing and introducing promising methods into the system of physical education of citizens.
units.label: Point 1

units.locator: ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN PHYSICAL CULTURE AND SPORT
units.text: 2. Up to 15 Prizes, each of 1000 thousand roubles, shall be awarded annually on the eve of Physical Culture Day.
units.label: Point 2

units.locator: ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN PHYSICAL CULTURE AND SPORT
units.text: 3. Materials and works shall be submitted for the Prize to the Department of Sport of the City of Moscow by state authorities, local self-government bodies and organizations.
units.label: Point 3

units.locator: ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN PHYSICAL CULTURE AND SPORT
units.text: Materials and works submitted for the Prize shall be accepted by the Department of Sport of the City of Moscow annually until 01.04, provided that they were made public at least one year before the closing date for submissions.
units.label: Point 3 · “Materials and works submitted for the Prize shall be accepted…”

units.locator: ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN PHYSICAL CULTURE AND SPORT
units.text: 4. Simultaneous nomination for the Prize for two or more activities and works is not permitted.
units.label: Point 4

units.locator: ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN PHYSICAL CULTURE AND SPORT
units.text: 5. A team submitting materials and works for the Prize must include only those authors whose contribution to the work was decisive.
units.label: Point 5

units.locator: ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN PHYSICAL CULTURE AND SPORT
units.text: A team of authors may not comprise more than ten persons.
units.label: Point 5 · “A team of authors may not comprise more than ten persons.”

units.locator: ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN PHYSICAL CULTURE AND SPORT
units.text: 6. Materials and works submitted for the Prize, and teams submitting materials and works for the Prize, shall not be considered if they have been nominated for other prizes or other awards.
units.label: Point 6

units.locator: ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN PHYSICAL CULTURE AND SPORT
units.text: 7. Materials and works may be submitted for the Prize only after publication, broad public discussion and implementation in the practice of physical culture and sport.
units.label: Point 7

units.locator: ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN PHYSICAL CULTURE AND SPORT
units.text: Materials and works nominated for the Prize shall be discussed among the staff collectives of organizations and institutions and in the mass media. Materials from those discussions shall be sent to the Department of Sport of the City of Moscow.
units.label: Point 7 · “Materials and works nominated for the Prize shall be discussed…”

units.locator: ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN PHYSICAL CULTURE AND SPORT
units.text: 8. Materials and works submitted for the Prize shall be considered by the expert council for awarding the Prize (hereinafter, the expert council) attached to the Department of Sport of the City of Moscow.
units.label: Point 8

units.locator: ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN PHYSICAL CULTURE AND SPORT

units.text: 10.
